title: The Lightning Lesson
description: A wise cloud explains lightning to curious children in the forest

scenes.visual_prompt: storybook style illustration, three curious children (hut, tree, tower) looking up at a cloud
scenes.negative_prompt: blurry, dark, low resolution, scary, violent
scenes.narration: Hut [excited]: What is lightning? Tree [curious]: Why does it flash? Tower [nervous]: Is it dangerous?
scenes.subtitle: The Questions
scenes.motion_prompt: children looking up curiously at cloud

scenes.visual_prompt: (medium shot:1.2) wise old cloud with kind eyes, speaking down to hut, tree, and tower, storybook style:1.3
scenes.negative_prompt: blurry, dark, low resolution, distorted, scary, extra limbs
scenes.narration: Cloud: Children, lightning is just electricity trying to reach the ground. It looks for the shortest and easiest path. Taller things are closer, and if they are good conductors, like metal, they attract lightning even more.
scenes.subtitle: The Wise Cloud
scenes.motion_prompt: cloud glowing softly as it speaks

scenes.visual_prompt: storybook style illustration, children nodding and smiling, understanding the explanation
scenes.negative_prompt: blurry, dark, low resolution, scary, violent
scenes.narration: Hut [excited]: Oh! So that's why lightning hits tall buildings! Tree [wise]: And metal things! Tower [confident]: Now I understand!
scenes.subtitle: Understanding
scenes.motion_prompt: children nodding and smiling with understanding

scenes.visual_prompt: storybook style illustration, wise cloud smiling down at the children with a gentle glow
scenes.negative_prompt: blurry, dark, low resolution, scary, violent
scenes.narration: Cloud [slow, wise]: Exactly! Lightning is nature's way of balancing electricity. It's beautiful and powerful, but also [pause] dangerous. Always stay safe during storms.
scenes.subtitle: Final Wisdom

scenes.visual_prompt: storybook style illustration, children waving and smiling at the cloud
scenes.negative_prompt: blurry, dark, low resolution, scary, violent
scenes.narration: All children [excited]: Thank you, wise cloud! We learned so much! The cloud [magical] smiled and drifted away, leaving the children wiser and safer.
scenes.subtitle: Gratitude
scenes.motion_prompt: children waving goodbye to the cloud
